items.title: Zeke Mullins interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 9, 2017
items.q: Oh, I respect those guys highly. Boy they were tremendous musicians, Dizzy and Bird.

ctx.x: What did you think of the late 40s and the early 50s with Dizzy and Charlie Parker and —
Oh, I respect those guys highly. Boy they were tremendous musicians, Dizzy and Bird. And they started something man. It was artistic. They started something. Yeah.
